name: – Eleonora Meleti, Rosa Estaràs Ferragut – § 14
title: REPORT on advancing towards a care society: addressing the gender care gap
part_text: Considers that a care society recognises the vital role of care, encompassing both formal and informal care, throughout every stage of life, and integrates it into its policies, addressing all types of care provided predominantly by women, including early childhood education and care and long-term care;
